findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_inbin_email, create_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, claim_connection_status, join_inbox · Private data: claim_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, claim_connection_status, join_inbox · Public sink: verify_inbin_email, create_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox, claim_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, join_inbox · Destructive: await_trial_inbox.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_inbin_email, create_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, claim_connection_status, join_inbox · Private data: claim_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, claim_connection_status, join_inbox · Public sink: verify_inbin_email, create_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox, claim_trial_inbox, await_trial_inbox_claim, join_inbox · Destructive: await_trial_inbox

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
